leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a recursive backtracking function to explore candidate combinations
Construct a base case to validate when a target sum is achieved
Manipulate arrays to build and store valid combination sequences
Initialize and update parameters to track current sum and index position
Control recursion depth by pruning branches that exceed the target sum
Integrate sorting to handle duplicate combinations efficiently
Render the final solution by returning all valid combinations
